verified: Enchant creature (kw.line); Enchanted creature can't attack unless its controller pays {3} (sta.edhv28.aura.attackTax: an attackTax rule modification of the creature the Aura is attached to, whatever it attacks: `defenders` any, CR 508.1h; paid as the attack is declared, CR 508.1d, 508.1i; again in each combat phase). Rulings read 2026-10-30: the cost is an additional cost of declaring the attacker (2004-10-04).

Enchant creature (kw.line); Enchanted creature can't attack or block unless its controller pays {1} for each card in your hand (sta.edhv28.aura.attackBlockTax.perHandCard: an attackTax and a blockTax of the enchanted creature, each {1} for each card in the Aura controller's hand when the declaration is made, CR 508.1h, 509.1d, 402.1). No Scryfall rulings.

{G}, Sacrifice this artifact: Until end of turn, target land becomes a 3/3 creature that's still a land (eff.edhv28.becomes.creature.thatsStillLand.durFirst: layer 4 adds Creature, layer 7b base 3/3, until end of turn; the land keeps its types, CR 205.1b, 611.2a, 613.1d, 613.4b); {1}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card (eff.draw.you). Ruling 2008-08-01: a land that becomes a creature can attack only if controlled since the start of the turn (rule engine, CR 302.6).

{T}: Until end of turn, target Forest becomes an X/X Treefolk creature in addition to its other types, where X is the number of Elves you control (eff.edhv28.becomes.xx.subtype.creature.inAddition.whereX: layer 4 adds Creature and the subtype Treefolk, layer 7b base X/X, X counted once as the ability resolves, CR 107.3, 608.2h, 613.4b). Rulings read 2026-10-30: X is determined on resolution and does not change later (2007-10-01).

Enchant land (kw.line); Enchanted land is a Mountain, Forest, and Plains (sta.edhv28.enchantedLand.isThreeBasicTypes: layer 4 sets the land types, so the land loses its other land types and the abilities of its rules text, CR 305.7, 205.3i, 303.4). Ruling 2008-10-01: it has the three mana abilities and keeps its name.

~ gets +1/+1 as long as you control another Merfolk or an Island (abl.pump.aslong over a cond `any` of two exists, parser/holes/cond.ts#control, 'another' the first description's alone, CR 604.1, 611.3a). Ruling 2017-09-29: +1/+1 once however many; checked continuously.

Players skip their upkeep steps (rep.edhv28.players.skip.step.upkeep: a replacement of every player's upkeep step by nothing, CR 614.10, 503.1). Rulings 2004-12-01: upkeep triggers don't trigger and the turn goes from untap to draw.

At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life unless an opponent has 10 or less life (trg.at, eff.fxz.unless.cond over `not` of countPlayers lifeIs, CR 603.1, 608.2c, 119.1). Ruling 2018-03-16: checked only as the ability resolves.

If damage would be dealt to a player, that player exiles that many cards from the top of their library instead (rep.edhv28.damageToPlayer.instead.exileTopThatMany: every player, the damage replaced by exiling that many cards from the top of the damaged player's library, CR 614.1a, 120.3, 406.2). Rulings 2004-10-04: affects all players; no cards in the library: nothing happens.

Kicker {2} (kw.line); Destroy target artifact if its mana value is 2 or less (eff.r4dig.destroy.if). If this spell was kicked, destroy that artifact if its mana value is 5 or less instead (rid.edhv28.destroy.thatArtifact.ifMv.instead: an if step, kicked: destroy under limit 5, else limit 2; CR 614.15, 702.33d, 202.3). Rulings read 2026-10-30: a spell is kicked when its kicker cost was paid (2024-11-08).

Kicker {2}{W} (kw.line); Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield (eff.return.bf). If this spell was kicked, you gain life equal to that card's mana value. Otherwise, you lose that much life (cond.if, eff.gainlife.equal, fl.otherwise, eff.loselife: an if step with else, the same life amount, CR 608.2c, 119.3, 702.33d). Ruling 2022-09-09: an illegal target means nothing happens.

{U}: Target creature becomes an artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn (existing template); {U}: Until end of turn, target artifact creature becomes blue and isn't an artifact (eff.edhv28.becomes.color.isntArtifact.durFirst: layer 5 sets blue, layer 4 removes the type Artifact and with it the artifact subtypes, CR 205.1a, 205.3d, 105.3, 613.1d-e). Rulings 2004-12-01: other types and supertypes stay.

Kicker {2}{U} (kw.line); When this enchantment enters, if it was kicked, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying (trg.when, eff.token.you); Whenever you cast a kicked spell, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying (the cast event of the controller with a spell filter `kicked`, edh-next-13's reading of "kicked spells", CR 603.1, 702.33d, 601.2i). Rulings read 2026-10-30: a spell is kicked when its kicker cost was paid (2024-11-08).
